title: Riot Squad Pod Liq Blueberry Lemonade 80ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pod Liq Shortfills are the latest innovation from Riot Squad that let you enjoy the long-lasting value and great flavours of Shortfill E-liquids in a huge variety of vape kits that use higher-resistance coils. Pod Liq’s unique 60%PG/40%VG ratio is tailor-made for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vaping with its perfect balance of vapour, flavour and throat hit. Available in 120ml bottles with 80ml of 0mg E-liquid, you have the freedom to tailor your nicotine content with the use of Nicotine Shots . Two x 10ml 18mg 70/30 Nicotine Shots added to an 80ml Shortfill bottle of Riot Squad Pod Liq E-liquid will create approximately 100ml of 3mg 50/50 E-liquid. while Four x 10ml 18mg 70/30 Nicotine Shots added to an 80ml Shortfill bottle of Riot Squad Pod Liq E-liquid will create approximately 120ml of 6mg 50/50 E-liquid. Step into a world where classic refreshment meets fruity exuberance with Riot Squad's Blueberry Lemonade 60/40 Shortfill E-liquid. This e-liquid is the epitome of a summer classic reimagined, capturing the essence of chilled lemonade infused with a burst of juicy blueberries. It's as if you're sitting at a countryside fair, sipping on homemade lemonade with a blueberry twist. From the moment you take that first inhale, the sharp, invigorating notes of lemonade make their presence felt, mimicking the refreshing sensation of a cold drink on a hot day. Just when you think the experience peaks there, the flavour evolves to introduce the sweet, nuanced notes of ripe blueberries. Together, they create a profile that is equal parts tart and sweet, offering a vaping experience that is layered, textured, and incredibly satisfying.
